title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_191.txt
concise_summary: PKD attempts to decode the nature of 'Thomas'—a supernatural personality that possessed him in 1971 and 2-3-74—as a time-traveling agent deployed from the future by a secret Christian revolutionary conspiracy. He constructs an elaborate temporal theology in which Christ is an immortal political revolutionary and Christianity a coded cover for an esoteric order working to establish a literal Kingdom of God on Earth, with himself as part of their weaponized machinery. The entry synthesizes paranoia, gnostic dualism, and his own fiction (especially *Tears* and the Xerox Missive) into evidence of retroactive reality-manipulation through tachyons, while acknowledging that his mind has been scrambled to prevent full understanding.
key_claims: There exists an esoteric inner circle of 'true secret Christians' with supernatural dominion over reality (space, time) working to overthrow the Roman Empire (here, standing for all tyranny), which continues under the guise of the churches themselves.
Christ is a secret immortal revolutionary still alive, not dead, and resurrection is literal and ongoing—Christianity as religion is an exoteric cover to obscure this political-supernatural reality.

PKD's own consciousness was bisected: a supernatural personality named Thomas was implanted in 1971 by future agents of this conspiracy to prepare him for his 2-3-74 visions and the publication of *Tears*.

The Xerox Missive, the *Tears* manuscript, and the 'taco stand' experience in Orange County represent retroactive temporal manipulations engineered by a conspiracy to prevent Nixon's tyranny from becoming permanent.

Diana, whom PKD encountered in visions, is Sophia (divine feminine principle) = Jesus Christ, the rightful ruler ousted by the false patriarchal 'regent' (false god/Satan), and her return is imminent.

A 'scrambler' (perhaps benign, perhaps demonic) prevents PKD from fully accessing or articulating his true knowledge, leaving him trapped in recursive doubt about what 'really' happened across the timetrack divergence.

tensions: Was Thomas created in 1971 to prepare PKD, or did PKD from 1971 travel forward to 1974 and then back? The temporal causality is inverted and unresolvable.
If the change was retroactive and erased Track A, how can PKD remember anything of Track A? He attributes this to residual subcortical impressions in Thomas, but admits the logic breaks.
The Golden Fish 'restored his real memories,' but the scrambler now prevents him from articulating or stabilizing what those memories contain. He knows he knows, but cannot prove or articulate.
The conspiracy may be benign (true Christians), hostile (US G2), or divine (Zebra/Plasmate)—he cannot determine the agency or intent.

Christianity claims to be eschatological (expecting imminent Kingdom), but 2000 years have passed with no literal Kingdom manifested—yet PKD insists the secret inner circle IS manifesting it retroactively.
If Diana/Sophia is Christ, and Christ is male in tradition, how does PKD reconcile the gender collapse? He asserts it without resolving it.
PKD claims he was 'phased out' by Thomas, not that Thomas phased in—but that implies PKD's current memory is all Track B, and Track A-PKD is lost forever.
The Xerox Missive appears to be a trap or bait, but PKD also credits it with prophetic knowledge—so is it enemy intelligence or divine instruction?

uncertainty_flags: The 'taco stand' experience dates are conflicting and unclear: PKD places it in both 1971 and 1974, in both Santa Monica and Orange County, as both a single incident and something lasting 'weeks.'
Thomas's actual status is ambiguous: Is he PKD's suppressed alternate personality, a time-traveling agent, a demonic possession, or a created consciousness? PKD wavers.
The Roogna letter identity is unclear; PKD mentions it as mistaken trigger material, but does not explain the source or full context.
Hal's guess about 'two me's' is accepted as evidence, but Hal is not identified and his basis for this claim is not given.
The Bar-B-Q incident is mentioned without explanation; the connection to a missing Canada trip and PKD's relocation to Fullerton is unclear.
PKD claims the Golden Fish 'restored' real memories, but these restored memories are never explicitly stated, only alluded to.
The nature of the 'scrambler' is tripled: possibly defensive screen, possibly enemy work, possibly benign divine obscuring. All three are offered simultaneously without adjudication.
How a US Army G2 letter could contain 'encoded revolutionary Christianity' is not explained; the semiotic leap is ungrounded.
The temporal mechanics of 'tachyons' enabling retroactive change are invoked but not developed—it is speculation presented as hypothesis.
Angela Davis is mentioned only as '(Angela Davis.)' in parentheses after a parenthetical note; her role is wholly cryptic.
